Conference contributions are treated as scholarly outputs, but they are presented here rather than duplicated under Publications. {{< include _generated.md >}}

## Catalogue policy

The authoritative source for current formal scholarly outputs is `qselmer/qselmer/assets/data/publications.json`, synchronized to this website as `assets/data/publications.json`. `talks/registry.json` stores presentation-level metadata that ORCID does not reliably provide, such as presentation type, event date, location, presenter, and stable `/talks/` routes.

A small `historical_records` block in the same registry may retain legitimate conference content from the previous public site when it is not yet represented in the canonical profile catalogue. Such records must be labelled as historical and cannot claim an external proceedings source until that source is verified.
